definitions: To become or cause someone to become extremely emotional, agitated, or lose control, often due to stress, fear, or excitement.
To react very strongly and often negatively to something.
To experience or cause to experience hallucinations or paranoia, especially as a result of drug use.
examples: Don't freak out, but I accidentally deleted the file.
The loud noise made the baby freak out.
He freaked out when he saw the spider.
She freaks out before every exam.
